works.version: Physical Review C 87, 044328 (2013), archive reprint with one cover and ten main pages
scope: PDF2–6 experiment, DCO and polarimeter calibration
checks: PDF6 Table I separates asymmetry, deduced P and Q for calibration. PDF7–8 Table II reports A for the 91Ru transitions and distinct DCO gate information.
PDF7 328.0 keV row gives RDCO=1.06(5) at 898-keV gate and A=-0.25(4). Visual check corrects the 435.9-keV entry to A=0.17(7).
works.gap: DCO gate labels do not uniquely define line-specific polarimetry selection. Conversion to P requires the calibrated response and its conditions.
works.lineage: One EXOGAM acquisition and associated calibration; preprint and archive reprint do not supply duplicate experiments.
